description: Signal router, two channels, with two gate inputs and logic between them

params.text: Sends HIGH to the output while it is held down; with latching on, each press swaps the output between HIGH and LOW
With latching on, the output swaps between HIGH and LOW whenever the logic state changes, rather than following it

inputs.text: With one gate patched, or none, the router follows that gate alone: HIGH reaches OUT while it is high, LOW otherwise
The mode can be set by a 0-5V CV, which overrides the button
The signal that reaches the output while the logic is true, or while the button is held
The signal that reaches the output while the logic is false

outputs.text: Whichever of the two signals the gates and the logic select

notes: with both patched, the routing follows the logic over the two gates
menu: Save latched state to patch — stores which channels are latched in the patch, so they come back latched when it is loaded
